title: LatchGitStatusV2
description: The Git state of one working tree on the gateway host (GET /v2/git/status?path=, control grant), parsed from `git status --porcelain=v2 -z --branch`. Reading it records the repository on the host's recent list. It never fetches: ahead/behind are against the remote-tracking ref as last fetched, and lastFetchedAt says when that was.

path.description: Path relative to the root, for display. Bytes that are not UTF-8 are shown as U+FFFD.

pathKey.description: The path's exact bytes, hex-encoded. The diff route takes this, never the display path.

origPath.description: The path before a staged rename or copy.

conflict.description: Git's two-letter unmerged code (UU, AA, DU, ...) for a conflicted entry.

fingerprint.description: Digest of this entry as the host saw it: Git's record for the path and, outside the staged area, the file's size, modification time and inode. A stage or unstage of selected files sends it back; a different value on the host means the file changed after it was shown, and the request is refused as refresh_required.

preconditions.description: The state a mutation was reviewed against. The phone copies these from the status (or branch list) it showed and sends them back unchanged; each operation rechecks the parts that matter to it, on the host, immediately before acting.

branch.description: Checked-out branch, or null when HEAD is detached.

head.description: HEAD's commit, or null on an unborn branch.

index.description: Digest of every index-side difference from HEAD (staged and conflicted records with their object ids) plus any operation in progress.

worktree.description: Digest of every record status listed, with each unstaged, untracked or conflicted file's size, modification time and inode.

branch.description: The checked-out branch, or null when HEAD is detached.

oid.description: The commit HEAD names, or null on an unborn branch.

name.description: The tracking ref, such as origin/main.

ahead.description: Null when the tracking ref no longer exists locally.

lastFetchedAt.description: RFC 3339 modification time of FETCH_HEAD, or null when this worktree has never fetched.

headName.description: Rebase: the branch being rebased (without refs/heads/), or null for a detached HEAD.

onto.description: Rebase: the commit being rebased onto.

stoppedAt.description: Rebase: the commit Git stopped at, when it recorded one.

summary.description: Merge: the first line of the message Git prepared, such as "Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main'". At most 200 characters.

operation.description: The merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert in progress. Detail fields are omitted when Git did not record them.

entriesTruncated.description: True when more changes exist than fit in one response.

observedAt.description: RFC 3339 time the host read this state.
